premises.text: Enterprises leave source code and sensitive data largely unencrypted because encryption makes data unsearchable and unusable for software teams
premises.evidence_span: encryption makes your data completely unsearchable and unusable

premises.text: Perimeter walls and alarms can be bypassed and only alert after breaches
premises.evidence_span: Walls can be bypassed, and alarms only alert you after the fact

premises.text: Searchable AES-256 encryption lets teams search encrypted data without revealing keys
premises.evidence_span: search encrypted data as easily and as quickly as Google can search web pages, all without revealing your key

premises.text: Git Zero is encrypted Git hosting that encrypts code and history while preserving searchable Git workflow via an encrypted index
premises.evidence_span: the world's first encrypted Git hosting that not only encrypts your source code, at the same time, allows you to search while it's all encrypted

value.text: Enterprises can encrypt source code and still search and use it in normal workflows
value.evidence_span: you should encrypt everything and search anything
